svg.title: Pin-in-paste: paste printed beyond the hole, drawn in when it melts
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, cross-sections through a 1.6 mm board. Left, after printing: solder paste fills the plated hole and is printed well beyond the pad onto the solder mask around it, and the pin has been pushed through it. Right, after reflow: the paste has melted and been drawn into the hole, filling it round the pin with a fillet on each side, leaving only flux residue on the mask where the paste was.

g.text: Several mm onto the solder mask
Only about half of it is metal
The extra paste was drawn in
Pushed through the paste after printing
Drawn to scale except copper thickness. Board 1.6 mm, hole 1.0 mm.
Leave room around the part for the extra paste (PCB-DFA-041).
